title: 第5章 两大世家的野心第6章 明月几时有
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
果然。
陈明这话刚一说出口。
江尘就怒声开口：“什么，萧云竟敢打本少女人的主意，看我不好好教训他。”
“走，我们这就去天香楼！”
话音落下。
江尘快速朝屋檐外走去，脸上充满了愤怒之色，仿佛真被气得不轻。
看着不断远去的江尘，陈明缓慢抬起了自己的头颅。
嘴角露出了一抹阴谋得逞的笑容。
随后便迈动自己的脚步。
快速跟了上去
然而。
他没发现的是。
走在前方的江尘，嘴角也微微上扬了几分，露出了一抹冷笑。
上次就是因为萧云，原宿主才死在自己的房屋之中，阴差阳错的成全了自己。
今天自己刚苏醒，萧云又迫不及待的来刺激自己，已经能表达出很多问题了。
【既然你这么想置我于死地，今晚少爷就陪你们好好玩玩，看看最后死的是谁。
想到这。
江尘眼中寒芒闪动。
……

半刻钟过后。
江尘来到了一座阁楼前，牌匾上写着天香楼三个大字，周围更是灯火通明。
一看到江尘的身影。
当即就有一个老妇人迎了上来。
人还未到。
声音就先传了过来：“江二少，你来得可是真准时啊，明月小姐马上就到了。”
“今天我们这里新来了几个姑娘，不知道江二少你有没有兴趣啊？”
“来，姑娘们，让江二少看看！”
随着老妇人话音一落。
几名妙龄女子从阁楼中走出，那纤细的腰肢暴露在空气中，那张微红的脸颊如同熟透的灵魂，让人忍不住想咬上一口。
不得不说。
这些女子确实算得上是美女。
但一回想到脑海中上官明月那张脸脸颊，以及那如同九天玄女般的气质，江尘瞬间就感觉一阵索然无味，再没有任何性趣。
轻轻摆了摆手。
开口说道：“不必了，我今天只为明月小姐而来，对其她人没有兴趣。”
一听这话。
老妇人脸上笑意更浓。
再次开口：“江二少真是深情啊，我相信你一定会如愿以偿的，你的专用包间可是一直都留着，直接上去就行。”
“嗯！”
江尘微微点头示意过后。

迈步朝天香阁内走去。
天香阁一共分为三层，每一层的价格都有所不同，在第一层人数最多。
那里只需要十枚金币，就可以给自己订到一个座位。
至于其他服务的话。
content_en:
………………
Sure enough.
As soon as Chen Ming said these words.
Jiang Chen said angrily: "What, Xiao Yun dares to take advantage of this young lady, see if I don't teach him a lesson."
"Let's go to Tianxiang Tower now!"
The words fell.
Jiang Chen quickly walked towards the eaves, his face full of anger, as if he was really angry.
Looking at Jiang Chen who was moving away, Chen Ming slowly raised his head.
A smile of triumphant conspiracy appeared on the corner of his mouth.
Then he took his own steps.
Followed quickly
However.
What he didn't find was.
Jiang Chen, who was walking in front, raised the corners of his mouth slightly, revealing a sneer.
Last time, it was because of Xiao Yun that the original host died in his own house, and he was fulfilled by a strange combination of circumstances.
He just woke up today, and Xiao Yun couldn't wait to stimulate himself. He was already able to express a lot of questions.
[Since you want to kill me so much, the young master will have some fun with you tonight and see who dies in the end.
Think of this.
Jiang Chen's eyes flashed with cold light.
…
Half an hour later.
Jiang Chen came to an attic. On the plaque were the words "Tianxiang Tower" and the surrounding area was brightly lit.
As soon as he saw Jiang Chen's figure.
An old woman came over immediately.
No one has arrived yet.
The voice came over first: "Second Young Master Jiang, you came on time. Miss Mingyue will be here soon."
"We have a few new girls here today. I wonder if you, Mr. Jiang, are interested?"
"Come on, girls, let Second Young Master Jiang take a look!"
As the old woman finished speaking.
Several young women walked out of the attic, their slender waists exposed to the air, and their reddish cheeks like a ripe soul, making people want to take a bite.
I have to say.
These women are indeed beauties.
But as soon as he recalled Shangguan Mingyue's face and cheeks in his mind, as well as her temperament like that of a mysterious goddess from the Nine Heavens, Jiang Chen instantly felt dull and devoid of any sexual interest.
He waved his hand gently.
He said, "No need, I'm here only for Miss Mingyue today and have no interest in anyone else."
Upon hearing this.
The smile on the old woman's face grew wider.
He spoke again: "Young Master Jiang is so affectionate. I believe you will get your wish. Your special private room has always been reserved. Just go up there."
"Yeah!"
Jiang Chen nodded slightly to indicate the situation.
He walked towards Tianxiang Pavilion.
Tianxiang Pavilion is divided into three floors. The price of each floor is different. The first floor has the most people.
You only need ten gold coins to book yourself a seat there.
As for other services.
